chunks: Whoever intentionally kills himself shall be in the Fire

key_terms.جَهَنَّمُ: Hell; the abode of divine punishment
key_terms.قَتَلَ: killed; refers here to the act of taking life
key_terms.نَفْسَهُ: himself; one's own soul or self

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about the punishment for intentional suicide?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام warns that deliberate self-killing is a grave sin with severe punishment in the hereafter. The hadith emphasizes the enormity of the act by linking it to Hellfire and enduring punishment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4953 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever intentionally kills himself will be in the Fire
